findings.problem: Tool calls do not check that a valid bundle is loaded; the store is touched only inside grants.check/allowed. With the bundle missing (/readyz 503), agent:t-alpha:nobody gets temporarily_unavailable for an existing a-secret note id and not_found for a missing id (existence oracle, SC-05 broken); an unknown tenant gets success {"boards": []} and an empty search. GR-12 MUST: without a valid bundle the service refuses calls. Severity major, not critical: no data, count or other tenant's object leaks; the signal is existence of an id the caller already holds, only during a policy outage.
findings.required_improvement: After self.refresh() in DemoTool.run read the store's `current` (raises temporarily_unavailable) before the handler, for every tool and tenant. Test: no bundle -> all three tools, for nobody, reader and an unknown tenant, existing and missing note ids, return the same temporarily_unavailable body, backend counter 0.

findings.problem: notes_search calls backend.search with an empty board list when the caller may read nothing. Measured: t-alpha:nobody -> calls {index: 1}; board_ids [] -> index 1; unknown tenant with index failed -> {index: 1, scan: 1} (slow scan for a zero-rights caller). _readable's docstring claims no backend call; test_nobody_does_not_reach_the_backend asserts only calls['boards'] == 0, so it checks not what its name says. In a real backend (the template) an empty filter often means no filter.
findings.required_improvement: Return the empty search result without calling backend.search when the board set is empty; assert sum(backend.calls.values()) == 0 for nobody, for board_ids [] and with index_failure set.

findings.problem: Schema paths and timeouts are declared in code and again in gxg-manifest.yaml; a test catches drift, but every tool is declared twice.
findings.required_improvement: Read input_schema, output_schema and limits.timeout_s from gxg-manifest.yaml; keep only the name->handler map (backlog).

findings.problem: Only GxgError is caught. A non-GxgError exception (probe: RuntimeError('backend exploded: demo-secret-XYZ') from get_note) returns its text to the agent in content, no structuredContent envelope, and the audit line has no outcome. Not reachable with the in-memory demo backend today.
findings.required_improvement: FastMCP('demo', mask_error_details=True) plus except Exception -> internal_error envelope and outcome internal_error (backlog M3 if score >= 9).

findings.problem: The reference connector imports TokenError and parse_public_key from the kit's private module gxg_connector_kit._jwt; the template will copy the private dependency.
findings.required_improvement: Export them from a public kit module and import from there (backlog).
